assets.name: blink
assets.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: individual animation pose PNG for a desktop paper-cat pet.
The attached reference image is the exact character reference, not a background. Use the same small cream-colored "paper cat" mascot drawn like a hand-cut paper sticker: soft warm cream paper texture, thick uneven dark-brown crayon outline, big round dark eyes with two tiny white sparkles when open, pink blush cheeks with little hatch lines, a ":3" mouth when not otherwise specified, pink inner ears, the tip of its right ear (on the viewer's right) folded over like a dog-eared paper corner, and a sage-green knotted neckerchief.
Keep the exact same character proportions, line weight, colors, and paper texture. Do not add new clothing or props unless asked. Flat illustration, no background, no ground shadow, no text, no labels, no watermark. Output a single complete character, centered, 1024x1024 PNG with an actual fully transparent alpha background, not a checkerboard or black fill. Preserve texture inside the character. Match the scale of the reference: same large head relative to body; the character occupies the same area and its lowest point touches a baseline at about 93% image height except the airborne cheer pose. Leave margin around every extremity.

POSE: Same sitting pose and framing as the reference, but with both eyes gently closed as soft downward curved lines. Everything else identical. Keep the same head outline, ear fold, scarf knot, paws and tail placement.

assets.name: walk-1
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Final animation frame, FULL COMPLETE CAT.
Edit the attached image itself. This exact cat is the mandatory design. Keep the enormous head, rectangular rounded face silhouette, eye, mouth, whiskers, ear folds, blush, small torso, scarf knot, tail, paper texture, all proportions, framing and positions unchanged. Do NOT create a different side-profile character, do NOT elongate the torso, do NOT shrink the head, do NOT change the current three-quarter left-facing pose.
Only reposition the FOUR SHORT LEGS/PAWS beneath the scarf to create the specified next walking frame. Whole character in every PNG, never isolated parts, never a rig or a sprite sheet. The upper head and scarf area must be visually identical to the reference. Keep the torso at the same location. Natural small steps, gently bent elbows/knees, no extra legs, no long human arms, no exaggerated reach.
Animation direction is LEFT. Grounded feet move toward RIGHT under the body during stance as the body travels left in the app. A foot travelling back toward the left must be lifted slightly; do not lift all feet simultaneously. Keep the sole of grounded NEAR paws at y952 in the1024 canvas, FAR paws at y938 to respect depth. Keep all existing transparent margins. Use unchanged body/head size and top position; no framing adjustments.
There are four legs: NEAR FRONT is the large central foreleg under the neck (neutral paw center x450); FAR FRONT is the smaller foreleg further LEFT (neutral x315); NEAR HIND is the large rightmost hindleg below rump (neutral x760); FAR HIND is the small paw between front and back near center-right (neutral x615), partly occluded. Preserve this exact existing leg style, toe marks, line weight and cream paper. Keep a clear gap between front and back legs. Four legs only.
Output one complete1024x1024 RGBA PNG, actual fully transparent background, no ground line, no shadow, no text or labels. Do not redraw the character into a new style.

FRAME 1 OF8: NEAR FRONT: paw center x390, sole y952, planted flat on floor; FAR FRONT: paw center x351, sole y938, planted flat on floor; NEAR HIND: paw center x789, sole y928, lifted for its forward swing, toes gently curled; FAR HIND: paw center x603, sole y938, planted flat on floor.
These coordinates describe only subtle foot changes; all other original pixels and character design should stay unchanged. Prioritize correct leg identity and smooth small stepping.
